name: Force enable emoticon plus feature

description: Don't expose your typing status to the other party.
name: Ghost Mode

name: Hide Main Ad

description: Hooks the Package Manager to bypass integrity checks.

description: Allows playing YouTube videos in KakaoTalk chat rooms.
name: Play YouTube player in chat room

name: Remove BizBoard ads

description: Removes the feed ad from the app.
name: Remove feed ad

description: Removes the focus ad from the app.
name: Remove focus ad

description: Removes the ad from the More tab.
name: Remove More tab ad

description: Removes the native ad from the app.
name: Remove native ad

description: Removes the OpenLink chat room list ad.
name: Remove OpenLink chat room list ad

description: Removes the shop tab from the bottom navigation bar.
name: Remove shop tab

description: Removes the Short-form tab from the now fragment.
name: Remove Short-form Tab

description: Allows you to see deleted/hidden messages in chat logs.
name: Show deleted or hidden messages

description: Spoofs the apk checksums to pass integrity checks.
name: Spoof apk checksums

description: Spoofs the App ID to bypass integrity checks. (to bypass biometric auth etc.)
name: Spoof App ID

description: Spoofs the app signature to bypass integrity checks.
name: Spoof Signature

description: Spoofs the app signature to pass integrity checks.
name: Spoof signature

description: It allows you to install the clone app just like the original.
name: Update Provider Patch

description: Patches the version info to include '(ReVanced)' in the version string.
name: Version info patch

description: Hides the Follow button on reels, the pills that push Edits, templates, Meta AI and Ray-Ban Meta glasses, and friends' activity with the comment preview. Each part has its own switch.
name: Clean up Reels

description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in HushGram's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays.
name: Default playback quality

description: Sends Instagram's usage events and crash reports to an address on your phone that refuses them, instead of to Instagram's and Facebook's servers. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens, which would come back on every start without those events. Restart Instagram after changing the switch.
name: Disable analytics

description: Stops telling Instagram which reels you watched and how far into them you got. It's used to rank your Reels, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back.
name: Don't send reel watch history

description: Adds Download to every reel's more menu. Reels save at the Download quality you set, best by default, without Instagram's watermark.
name: Download any reel

description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. A video saves at the Download quality you set, a photo at its largest size.
name: Download any story

description: Adds Download to the menu of a post in your feed with a video, and of a carousel showing a video. Videos save at the Download quality you set, without Instagram's watermark. A second switch does the same for photo posts.
name: Download any video

description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories. Instagram is told the ad didn't go in, so no gap is left where it would have been.
name: Hide ads

description: Takes the New group button away from beside the share sheet's search bar, and the button that sends to the people you picked as one group, so they get it one by one. You can still start a group from your messages.
name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet

description: Takes Meta AI out of the search bars, in the Search tab and at the top of your messages, so they search the plain way, drops the Ask a follow-up bar under search results and Meta AI's buttons in Home's top bar, and removes Meta AI's posts from your home feed. Each has its own switch, and the search one shows once Instagram restarts.
name: Hide Meta AI

description: Removes the rows of suggested reels between posts in your home feed, and the other units that open the Reels viewer from there. A reel someone you follow posts stays.
name: Hide Reels in the feed

description: Removes the posts and reels from accounts you don't follow that Instagram puts in your home feed as Suggested for you, the rows of accounts, shops and hashtags it suggests you follow, and the posts and accounts from Threads it mixes in. Each has its own switch. Posts from accounts you follow stay.
name: Hide suggested posts

description: Removes the stories from accounts you don't follow, and the accounts Instagram suggests, from the row of stories at the top of Home. A second switch, off to start, takes the whole row away.
name: Hide suggested stories

description: Empties the grid of posts and reels under the Search tab's bar. Search, your recent searches and search results stay.
name: Hide the Explore grid

description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar, and a start or a notification meant for it opens Home. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open, and a change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.
name: Hide the Reels tab

description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still sends a post or reel to someone.
name: Hide the Repost button

description: Adds HushGram settings to Instagram. Long-press Instagram's launcher icon and pick HushGram settings, or tap HushGram settings at the top of Instagram's Settings and activity, to turn features on or off, pause HushGram and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.
name: HushGram settings

description: Lock a reel at 2x with Instagram's own lock (hold its edge, then slide down) and the next reels play at 2x too, until you slide the lock off, hold the edge and let go, or Instagram restarts.
name: Keep the reel speed

description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where its server flags (MetaConfig and quick experiments) can be looked at and overridden on your phone. A wrong flag can break parts of Instagram until you reset it there.
name: Open developer options

description: Opens a web link you tap in your default browser instead of Instagram's in-app browser, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram and other Meta pages, and ads, still open in the app.
name: Open links in external browser

description: Instagram's dark mode uses pure black instead of its near-black gray, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus, sheets and buttons keep their own grays so they stay easy to see. Chosen when you patch, with no switch.
name: Pure black dark mode

description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build doesn't update on its own, so without this it would stop working after a few weeks.
name: Remove build expired popup

description: Instagram can't read your phone's advertising ID or tell Android's ad services which ads you saw or tapped. The permissions for them are taken out of the build, so Google Play services hands Instagram a string of zeros in place of the ID.
name: Remove the advertising ID

description: Takes away the empty room Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there, on a phone that hides its navigation bar and in a pop-up window. A change to the switch shows once Instagram restarts.
name: Remove the empty space at the bottom

description: Lets Instagram's own signature checks pass on a re-signed build, so the parts of the app that check who signed it keep working. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.
name: Restore trust on re-signed builds

description: A video or reel longer than two minutes that you left partway picks up where you left it the next time it plays. Live videos and ads start as usual. Its switch starts off.
name: Resume long videos

description: Takes stkn, igsh, utm_source and Instagram's other tracking keys off the links you copy or share, and opens a bio link without going through Instagram's click tracker. The post, reel, story or profile a link opens stays the same.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile, after their pronouns if they've set any. A switch in HushGram's settings turns it off.
name: Show if a profile follows you

description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow. Tap Following at the top to switch to For you, and Home remembers your pick. A second switch, off to start, takes For you out of Home. A change to either shows once Instagram restarts.
name: Start Home on Following

description: Keeps Instagram from crashing or freezing on an x86 device that runs its arm code through a translator, such as an x86 Chromebook or an emulator, by skipping the one code protection step that breaks there. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before.
name: Start on x86 devices

description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Turn the switch off for Instagram's timing.
name: Stop Story auto-advance

description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on the screen, or larger. Pick the size in HushGram's settings.
name: Story ring size

description: Videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves. Feed videos show a play button, the way they do when Instagram saves mobile data.
name: Tap to play

description: Stops a double tap on a post or a reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. A single tap still does what it did, and the Like button still likes.
name: Turn off double tap to like

description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch, because Instagram isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you, and stories you've watched keep showing as new.
name: View stories anonymously

name: Bring back twitter

name: Clear tracking params

description: Change the download directory for video downloads
name: Custom download folder

name: Custom sharing domain

description: Delete entries from database(cache)
name: Delete from database

description: Unlocks the ability to download videos and gifs from Twitter/X
name: Download patch

description: Replaces the default Blue accent with the user's Material You palette and Dim, Light Theme with Full Material Design.
name: Dynamic color

description: Sets app version to a default value making installation of different versions possible
name: Enable app downgrading

description: Enables "Reader Mode" on long threads
name: Enable Reader Mode

description: Enables ability to undo posts before posting
name: Enable Undo Posts

description: Makes all app activities exportable.
name: Export all activities

description: Get translate option for all posts
name: Force enable translate

description: Hide new post banner
name: Hide Banner

description: Adds an option to hide Floating action button
name: Hide FAB

description: Removes swipe up for more videos in video player
name: Hide immersive player

description: Hides promote button under self posts
name: Hide promote button

description: Hide recommended users that pops up when you follow someone
name: Hide Recommended Users

description: Get rid of t.co short urls.
name: No shortened URL

description: Instead of open the link directly in one of the installed browsers
name: Open browser chooser on opening links
